title: Lightly Toasted Russian Beef Casserole
description: A hearty Russian dish featuring tender beef, melted cheese, and crunchy breadcrumbs, perfect for a cozy dinner. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and serves 6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the garlic-infused oil over medium heat and cook the beef strips until browned.
In a separate bowl, mix the sour cream, shredded cheese, and chopped onion.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked beef strips.
Spread half of the sour cream mixture over the beef layer.
Sprinkle half of the breadcrumbs over the sour cream layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the beef, then the remaining sour cream mixture, and finally the remaining breadcrumbs.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly toasted and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
